name: Spot The Difference Daily
author: Addicting Games
description: Spot the Difference Daily is a puzzle game where you must spot the differences between two images. No, we’re not pranking you as Jim does with Dwight! There are 10 differences between the two images you are seeing. Some of the differences may be obvious, but others won’t be easy to catch. Check every nook and cranny before throwing in the towel, and taking a hint. Your score is determined by the amount of time you take to solve the puzzle. The faster you solve it, the better your score. Wrong guesses and hints add time to your score. Play quickly and become one of the top players of this online puzzle game. Tune in every day for a new puzzle to solve! You can join Shockwave Unlimited, our sister site if you want to play more puzzle games.
